dashboard.assistentUitleg: The AI assistant answers questions using the published articles and escalates automatically whenever something is not covered in the knowledge base.

onboarding.uitleg: The procedures that are relevant to your role. Tick an article off once you have read it — this is just for you, to keep track of your progress.
onboarding.geenToegang: No articles are available for your access level yet. Ask Martijn to set up your knowledge access.
onboarding.leerpadUitleg: Work through these articles in order. The foundations first (verifying, when to create a ticket, escalating), then the concrete customer questions.

assistent.introTekst: Ask a question about a procedure. The answer always points to the article it used — and if it isn't in the knowledge base, the assistant escalates to Martijn rather than guessing.

leveranciers.introTekst: Which carrier each supplier uses, and whether tracking is available (automatically) — for NL, BE and UK in a single overview, so support doesn't have to switch between two lists.
leveranciers.geenResultaten: No suppliers found for this filter.

overzicht.artikelbeheerTekst: View, edit and publish every article.
overzicht.escalatiesTekst: Questions the assistant could not answer with confidence.
overzicht.feedbackTekst: Answers a colleague marked as unhelpful.
overzicht.voorstellenTekst: Patterns the AI spotted in recurring escalations.
overzicht.gebruikersTekst: Invite colleagues and decide what they get in the AI context.
overzicht.exportTekst: Download the entire knowledge base as a zip file.
overzicht.reviewVerlopenTekst: Published articles whose review date has passed. Check the content and mark as reviewed, or mark as out of date.

nieuw.typeToelichting: The type determines the template: conversation route (customer says X → what do you ask), procedure (steps in a system), reference (options and when to pick which) or product training (expertise needed to advise).
nieuw.toelichting: You will go straight to the editor next. Publishing is a separate step, once the content is ready.

escalaties.inleiding: Questions the AI assistant could not answer with confidence from the knowledge base. Every open escalation is a gap in the knowledge base — work the question into an article and then tick it off.

export.inleidingVoor: Downloads the entire knowledge base as a zip file: every article as a separate Markdown file, plus a single
export.inleidingNa: holding all metadata, categories and tags. This keeps the knowledge base independent of this app — with these files you can always carry on, even without Supabase or Anthropic.
export.totalen: {artikelen} articles, {categorieen} categories and {tags} tags in total. Every status is included — this is a full backup, not a public export.

feedback.inleiding: Answers a colleague marked with 👎. Unlike an escalation, the assistant did cite an article here — but that article did not help. Often a sign that the article is unclear, incomplete or out of date.

gebruikers.inleiding: Create accounts with a temporary password and set each colleague's role and which categories they see in the AI assistant and the onboarding checklist. “Start here” is always visible. Tick nothing under knowledge access to grant unrestricted access.
gebruikers.toegangToelichting: Knowledge access applies only to staff and editors — administrators always see everything.
gebruikers.wachtwoordToelichting: Share this password securely with the colleague — they can change it themselves on their account after signing in.

voorstellen.inleiding: Patterns the AI spotted in recurring escalations. The AI never invents the procedure itself — fill that in before you publish.
voorstellen.geenOpen: No open proposals. Click above to have the escalations analysed.
voorstellen.genererenTekst: Let the AI review the open escalations and propose recurring patterns as draft articles. It never invents the procedure itself.
